victory lap.translation: n. 绕场一圈庆祝胜利

vicua.translation: 骆马（产于南美的骆驼科动物）

vicugna.definition:
n. A South American mammal (Auchenia vicunna) native of the
   elevated plains of the Andes, allied to the llama but smaller. It has a
   thick coat of very fine reddish brown wool, and long, pendent white
   hair on the breast and belly. It is hunted for its wool and flesh.

vicugna vicugna.translation: [网络] 骆马；小羊驼；骆马属

vicuna.definition:
n. the wool of the vicuna
n. a soft wool fabric made from the fleece of the vicuna
n. small wild cud-chewing Andean animal similar to the guanaco but smaller; valued for its fleecy undercoat

vicunas.translation: (vicuna 的复数) n. 骆马, 骆马绒
